# Unpublished SDK preview

Working-tree snapshot of the `viewer-react` SDK branch (see `manifest.json` for source and
tarball hashes), vendored so CI can verify the Convex integration before the Viewer alpha and the
`@transloadit/zod` Storage extractor are published. Replace these `file:` dependencies with the
published versions before merging; the package cannot be released while it depends on them.
